description: Cs₂Na₈U₈Mo₅O₄₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic I222 space group. There are two inequivalent Cs sites. In the first Cs site, Cs is bonded in a 12-coordinate geometry to twelve O atoms. There are a spread of Cs-O bond distances ranging from 2.92-3.53 Å. In the second Cs site, Cs is bonded in a 12-coordinate geometry to twelve O atoms. There are a spread of Cs-O bond distances ranging from 2.98-3.64 Å. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent UO₇ pentagonal bipyramids and edges with five NaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.55-2.73 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent UO₇ pentagonal bipyramids and edges with five NaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.60-2.72 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent UO₇ pentagonal bipyramids, edges with three NaO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one MoO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.49-2.61 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent UO₇ pentagonal bipyramids and edges with three NaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.47-2.58 Å. There are two inequivalent U sites. In the first U site, U is bonded to seven O atoms to form distorted UO₇ pentagonal bipyramids that share corners with four NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 57-61°. There are a spread of U-O bond distances ranging from 1.87-2.53 Å. In the second U site, U is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of U-O bond distances ranging from 1.89-2.74 Å. There are two inequivalent Mo sites. In the first Mo site, Mo is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.74-2.40 Å. In the second Mo site, Mo is bonded to four equivalent O atoms to form MoO₄ tetrahedra that share edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. All Mo-O bond lengths are 1.80 Å. There are eleven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one U atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one U atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Cs, two Na, and one U atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Cs, two Na, and one U atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one U and two equivalent Mo atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to two Cs, one U, and one Mo atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three U atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Cs, one Na, and two Mo atoms. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Cs, one Na, and one Mo atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to three U atoms. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two U and one Mo atom.
